title: Skill use
description: JSON Schema for a skill-use witness: the cell-level record of one skill invocation by one agent. Stratum-1 or stratum-2 atom in the stratified-predication-fiber.

with-input.description: Parameters bound at invocation. Shape determined by the invoked skill's requires-precondition.

produced-output.description: Output value. Shape determined by the invoked skill's requires-postcondition.
